prompt: Suggest three points for work from home policy on Fridays: hours, tools, tracking.
response:
Dear Ms. Rao,

I am writing to share recommendations for the upcoming Friday work-from-home initiative. Introducing this policy will boost morale while maintaining high productivity.

First, regarding working hours, I recommend standard core hours between 9:30 AM and 4:30 PM. This ensures that clients receive prompt support while offering employees needed flexibility.

Second, regarding communication tools, establishing Slack for instant team messaging and Zoom for video conferences will ensure clear and prompt coordination across departments.

Lastly, concerning performance tracking, we should implement weekly deliverables and objective KPI milestones rather than continuous online monitoring, encouraging ownership.

Thank you for considering these thoughts.

Best regards,
Rahul Verma
